cohort: Four women with MRKHS who underwent living-donor uterus transplantation
finding: Uterus transplantation from living donors can enable women with MRKHS to achieve successful pregnancies and childbirth, with careful selection of donor/recipient pairs, meticulous surgical technique, and comprehensive follow-up being crucial to success.
mod_finding: Two recipients, both requiring ovarian restimulation under immunosuppression after missed pregnancy loss in one case and no pregnancy in the other, each delivered a healthy boy by cesarean section.
